test.title: Maple Street Dental Practice — new patients

texts.title: Maple Street Dental Practice — new patients

paragraphs.text: Maple Street Dental Practice is accepting new patients. To register, please complete a registration form, which you can download from our website or collect from reception, and bring it to your first appointment together with a list of any medicines you take.
The practice is open from 8 am to 6 pm on weekdays and from 9 am to 1 pm on Saturdays. Emergency appointments are kept free every morning; please phone as soon as we open.
If you cannot attend an appointment, let us know at least 24 hours in advance. Patients who miss two appointments without telling us may be removed from our list.
Parking is available behind the building, and there is a bus stop on Maple Street, just two minutes’ walk away.
Children under 18 receive treatment free of charge. Adults pay according to the treatment they need, and a full price list is available at reception and on our website.

items.quote: together with a list of any medicines you take
items.prompt: First appointment: bring the form and a list of your 1 ____

explanation.en: “a list of any medicines you take” → medicines, plural as in the text.
explanation.kk: «a list of any medicines you take» → medicines, мәтіндегідей көпше түрде.
explanation.ru: «a list of any medicines you take» → medicines, во множественном числе, как в тексте.

items.quote: from 9 am to 1 pm on Saturdays

explanation.en: “from 9 am to 1 pm on Saturdays” → 1 pm. “6 pm” is weekday closing time, in the other half of the sentence.
explanation.kk: «from 9 am to 1 pm on Saturdays» → 1 pm. «6 pm» — жұмыс күндері жабылу уақыты, сөйлемнің көрші бөлігі.
explanation.ru: «from 9 am to 1 pm on Saturdays» → 1 pm. «6 pm» — время закрытия в будни, это соседняя часть предложения.

items.quote: Emergency appointments are kept free every morning

explanation.en: “kept free every morning” → morning. “Saturdays” and “weekdays” in the first sentence are opening days, not emergency times.
explanation.kk: «kept free every morning» → morning. Бірінші сөйлемдегі «Saturdays» мен «weekdays» — жұмыс күндері, шұғыл қабылдау уақыты емес.
explanation.ru: «kept free every morning» → morning. «Saturdays» и «weekdays» из первого предложения — дни работы, а не время срочного приёма.

items.quote: let us know at least 24 hours in advance
items.prompt: To cancel: give at least 4 ____ notice

explanation.en: “at least 24 hours in advance” → 24 hours. “Two appointments” in the next sentence is not a time limit.
explanation.kk: «at least 24 hours in advance» → 24 hours. Келесі сөйлемдегі «two appointments» — мерзім емес.
explanation.ru: «at least 24 hours in advance» → 24 hours. «Two appointments» в следующем предложении — не срок.

items.quote: Parking is available behind the building

explanation.en: “Parking is available behind the building” → behind. The bus stop “on Maple Street” is a different way to get there.
explanation.kk: «Parking is available behind the building» → behind. «on Maple Street» аялдамасы — жетудің басқа жолы.
explanation.ru: «Parking is available behind the building» → behind. Автобусная остановка «on Maple Street» — это другой способ добраться.
